decision_boundary: This manifest records a bounded comparison only. It does not approve PST or the project engine for Rotterdam production outputs.

comparison_implementation.description: The source hashes in engines identify the implementation bytes used for method-comparison-v1 at this revision. They are preserved as comparison-time evidence and are not hashes of the current PST adapter or worker.

acceptance_thresholds.fixture_node_count: exact after the documented origin-segment mapping

method.network_directionality: undirected; one-way attributes are not represented by this comparison adapter
method.project_radius_metric: cumulative shortest-path distance between segment midpoints; each transition adds half the current and half the next segment length

radius_evidence.documentation: PST Documentation v3.3.2, sections 3-4, describes walking radius as shortest network distance and straight radius as Euclidean distance; this manual is newer than the pinned 3.3.1 runtime.
radius_evidence.runtime_fixture: A 200 m side closed square at a 300 m radius matched project and PST walking counts for every segment; PST straight radius reached more segments from source A.
radius_evidence.comparison_status: walking mode used for the primary fixture comparison; the separate fixture distinguishes it from Euclidean straight radius

angular_cost.project: local turn angle in radians divided by pi/2 (90 degrees equals one turn)
angular_cost.pst: AngularIntegration and AngularChoice, angle_threshold=0 degrees and angle_precision=1
angular_cost.evidence: PST documentation describes angular distance in degrees divided by 90; a 30-degree fixture returned one-third turn in both engines within float precision.
angular_cost.comparison_status: fixture-verified; no claim about every geometry or native implementation edge case

segment_construction.explicit_unlinks: passed to CreateSegmentMap before graph construction; crossings marked unlinked remain disconnected
segment_construction.lineage: Every requested source line must have at least one returned segment; the adapter fails closed if coverage is missing.
segment_construction.topology_policy: Default preprocessing does not snap near-but-disconnected endpoints and does not discard short dead-end tails. Explicit caller settings may change this and must be recorded with each request.

raw_output_harmonization.node_count: PST returns the origin segment in its count on tested fixtures; compare PST node_count - 1 to the project count, which excludes the origin. Keep native PST counts in PSTResult.
raw_output_harmonization.total_depth: The frozen project engine exposes only six-decimal total_depth. Compare PST native output to that reported value; do not infer unavailable unrounded project values or relax the 1e-6 threshold. The 30-degree A/B fixture errors exceed the threshold, so fixture comparison is blocked pending an approved precision-preserving method.
raw_output_harmonization.choice: PST AngularChoice counts both path directions; compare PST choice / 2 to the project undirected pair count. The project engine exposes six-decimal choice; tested fixtures match within threshold. Keep native PST choices in PSTResult.
raw_output_harmonization.scope: The node-count and choice mappings are bounded by the fixture evidence and the cited PST documentation; they are not a universal approval for directed or length-weighted networks. This comparison does not approve either engine for Rotterdam production outputs.

normalization.inputs: Apply the same formulas to harmonized NC, PST native TD/choice, and the project's existing six-decimal TD/choice fields. The precision limitation remains a blocker; no threshold was changed.

method.isolated_components: A segment with no other reachable segments has harmonized NC=0, TD=0, choice=0, NAIN=0, and NACH=0 in synthetic fixtures.
method.boundary_effects: Not assessed on M4H; no regional network or clipped 800 m analysis was run.

fixture_comparison.node_count: exact for all 23 source lines after subtracting the PST origin segment
additional_diagnostic_fixtures: closed_square_radius: distinguishes walking from straight radius
short_tail_and_endpoint_gap: confirms 0 m default tail removal and snapping preserve requested topology
fixture_comparison.limits: Synthetic fixtures only. The frozen project engine reports TD and choice to six decimals; the 30-degree A/B TD error is 1.029802291725951e-6, exceeding the unchanged 1e-6 threshold. Unrounded project TD is unavailable without modifying a frozen parent, so no values are inferred and no threshold is relaxed. No M4H subnetwork, rank correlation, regional edge stability, or production method acceptance has been established.
